subject.title: fix(node): fail closed on invalid trusted-proxy CIDRs and warn on untrusted forwarding

question: Should malformed `CRABBOX_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS` unconditionally stop existing Node deployments at startup while unset or incomplete proxy trust remains warning-only?
rationale: The proposed policy trades coordinator availability during upgrades against stricter proxy-trust configuration and does not resolve the canonical unconfigured-proxy denial-of-service path.

options.title: Add opt-in strict mode
options.body: Preserve current startup behavior by default, add an explicit strict setting, and prove both compatibility and strict paths.

options.title: Accept unconditional fail-closed
options.body: Approve the startup break intentionally and require upgrade documentation plus fresh-install, upgrade, and recovery proof.

options.title: Land diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the warning and documentation while deferring fatal validation and the broader admission mitigation.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in strict mode
recommendation.body: Preserve current startup behavior by default, add an explicit strict setting, and prove both compatibility and strict paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available area-history candidate from the merged OAuth partitioning work, although final security-boundary approval requires a qualifying repository maintainer.
